name: @bbox-ui/glyph-content
description: The Glyph `content` grammar: encode/decode/compare for the encoded-string value a glyph field holds (lucide:<name>, emoji:<char>, a data:/http(s): image URL, text:<chars>, or ""), plus the two generated icon/emoji data files both picker lineages search. Zero dependencies — no React, no host engine, no picker UI.
